_comment: Example only. Copy to config/apply.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR OWN facts. This is the one place the apply assist may take a personal answer from (besides your resume). Every field is optional: a field you leave out means 'needs you' for any form question that depends on it, never a default or a guess. Equal opportunity (gender, ethnicity, veteran, disability) is 'Prefer not to say' unless you write something else here; it is never inferred. Years per skill are worked out from your resume's dates; put a number in experience.skill_years only to override that. Nothing here is ever stored in the database, put in a log or sent to Claude except the few facts one drafted answer needs. Check the file with: scripts/jobsearch validate, and see what is missing with: scripts/jobsearch apply sheet

custom.phrase: Are you comfortable working in a fast-paced startup
